q1_issues.issue: No (Symmetric Like) tag beside the relation, although 'are like' is exactly the stative mutual-by-meaning predicate the instruction set names ('is similar to', 'resembles'), so the reverse direction cannot be derived.
The explicit adversative connective 'but' is recorded nowhere - neither a surface-connective atom nor the defeasible-exception pattern - so the stated contrast between the two halves is lost.

q2_gaps: adversative 'but' joining a clause to an elliptical predicative PP ('but without the shell'): the connective rule requires two reified eventualities as endpoints, and neither a preposition-headed kind relation nor a bare copular kind claim supplies one

privative 'without NP' as a predicate (absence / lacking): no defined encoding, and no route to a strength-0 claim either, since 'without' is not one of the explicit not/n't/no/never negators that the instruction set says are required to set strength 0.0
entity-attached preposition-named obliques are defined for entities and events; using them between two bare KINDS - (Like slug snail), (Without slug shell) - is not addressed
notes: Like and Without are both licensed under the open surface-preposition licence ('like ...' is named explicitly in the never-coin-a-head rule), and the 0.9/0.9 truth values match the bare relational-generic band. Nothing is asserted beyond the words - in particular the shell is not attributed to snails.
